title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Sacred Geometry & Precision Metrology. Choose this direction, an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sacred Geometry & Polar Metrology
options.lineage: Traditional kolam dot-grid geometry fused with precision calibration lab charts
options.thesis: Dosa circularity analyzed as sacred radial symmetry meeting high-order computational metrology on a seasoned cast-iron coordinate plane.
options.viewport: Full-viewport seasoned iron tawa with glowing concentric calibration reticles, vernier calipers, and instant drop-zone.
options.risk: Can veer overly austere if the warmth of the dosa and golden ghee highlights are underplayed.

raised.raise: Batter swirl fluid dynamics and sambar surface tension are animated as active physical field lines.
Deadpan mock-academic callouts scale dynamically with hyperbolic typographical contrast.

options.label: The Darshini Metrology Bureau
options.lineage: Bengaluru/Chennai Darshini token counters and stainless steel tawa stations
options.thesis: High-velocity South Indian tawa ritual elevated to an official national standards bureau: stainless steel, brass tokens, and dot-matrix certificates.
options.viewport: Industrial stainless inspection bench with live thermal feed, dot-matrix telemetry readout, and token dispenser.
options.risk: Heavy brass and steel industrial textures might feel heavy if not balanced with crisp digital typography.

options.label: Rheological Fluid Dynamics Lab
options.lineage: Suminagashi ink basin & computational fluid mechanics
options.thesis: Treating batter fermentation viscosity, ladle spiral swirl vortex, and sambar dipping surface tension as pure hydrodynamic simulation.
options.viewport: Interactive fluid canvas showing real-time spiral batter spread vector fields and circularity deviation vectors.
options.case: Fuses beautifully with the physics of pouring batter on a tawa, providing genuine dynamic interactive delight.
options.risk: Requires rich canvas/WebGL shader rendering to avoid looking like a generic particle simulation.

options.label: Broadcast Teletext Metrology Service
options.lineage: Broadcast teletext Ceefax / Doordarshan diagnostic test signals
options.case: Lacks the culinary warmth and organic South Indian context of dosas; overly sterile retro-European broadcast.
options.kept: Rigid tabular monospace alignment for metric readouts.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark mode modern web app with glowing neon accents, card grids, and circular SVG progress bars.
canonCard.viewport: Hero header with floating circular dosa graphic and standard file upload dropzone.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other AI-generated dark-mode web tool.
